tools.name: todays_top_stories
tools.description: The day's top news stories for an industry, picked and ranked by nwsppr, each with why it matters, the original source link, and how soon a company should act. No sign-in. Leave industry out for a front page with the lead story from each industry. Every story includes its original source.

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: The plan and its add-ons, what each includes, the price when it's public, the industries nwsppr covers, and how buying works.

tools.name: start_signup
tools.description: Starts nwsppr for the person's company with their own work email, once they have asked for it or agreed to it (person_agreed). Nothing is charged: the reply has a message and usually a link (Stripe checkout or sign-in) for the person to open, or says they're on the waitlist.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "signup" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_signup · Public sink: start_signup.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_signup · Public sink: start_signup

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "todays_top_stories" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
